name: DeploymentLogs
title: Blocks/Detail/DeploymentLogs
summary: The deploy logs of a build or deploy run with known steps, wherever it is shown: `LogViewer.Steps` lists the pipeline as an Accordion of steps, each with its status glyph and the status in words for assistive technology, its title and sentence, its time and its own LogViewer, or every line as one continuous LogViewer in the Complete view, with a flush Progress on the bottom edge while it runs. On its own its toolbar row reports the step count and the step in flight, or the outcome Tag, the time and the Phased or Complete switch once it has settled. In a create flow (InCreateFlow) it sits in a Card titled Deployment that opens on a cloning splash (a source tile, a marching dashed connector and a large destination tile) with a Cloning StatusIndicator, and once a run fails the card header carries the view switch and its footer Edit and Redeploy. On a deployment page (DeploymentDetail, DeploymentError, DeploymentQueued) it is the Deployment logs card under a status banner and the Deployment details card. Built from `LogViewer` (`LogViewer.Steps`), `Tag`, `Card`, `StatusIndicator`, `ToggleGroup` and `Button`; the deployment pages add `Alert`, `Accordion`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton`, `EmptyState` and `Tooltip`. The deployment pages are page bodies for ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: A run that went live: every step checked, the last one open, a Completed Tag with Deployed in 42s and the view switch in the Logs row, and copy on every step log.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A run whose routing rules were rejected: that step is open on its error output with a Failed Tag and the reason in full, the steps behind it read Skipped, and the Logs row names the failed step beside the view switch.

variants.name: ContinuousLog
variants.summary: The Complete view of a finished run: every line the pipeline printed as one continuous LogViewer with its copy button.

variants.name: ContinuousLogError
variants.summary: The Complete view of the failed run: the lines up to the error, as one LogViewer, nothing from the steps that never ran.

variants.name: InCreateFlow
variants.summary: Deploy was just pressed in a create flow: the Deployment Card with a Cloning StatusIndicator in its header, opening on the cloning splash (the Git provider tile, a dashed connector marching toward a large destination tile, still under reduced motion) with one polite screen-reader line naming the repository and the scope; the steps replace the splash as the first one starts.

variants.name: InCreateFlowError
variants.summary: The create-flow card after the routing rules were rejected: the Deployment header swaps the status for the Phased or Complete switch, the Logs row names the failed step, that step is open on its error output with a Failed Tag, the steps behind it read Skipped, and the card footer offers Edit (back to the form, values kept) and Redeploy.

variants.name: DeploymentDetail
variants.summary: A deployment that went live: the success banner, the Deployment details card with every fact and its Deployment Settings band for Default, and the Deployment logs card with the run duration and the Phased or Complete switch over the steps.

variants.name: DeploymentError
variants.summary: A deployment the rules rejected: the danger banner with Redeploy, Visit disabled until the deployment is live, and the Deployment logs card with the Error status, open on the failed step with the rest skipped.

variants.name: DeploymentQueued
variants.summary: A deployment waiting for a runner: the info banner, Visit disabled until the deployment is live, the Deployment details card with Queued as its status and Not started as its duration, and the Deployment logs card with a Queued `StatusIndicator` in its header and a not-started `EmptyState` in place of the steps, with no Phased or Complete switch.
